name: Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd.
summary: Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd. is a global manufacturer and supplier of specialized high-precision screens and related screen printing materials. Their advanced precision screens are integral to various industries, finding applications in vehicle dashboard and packaging closure printing, textile manufacturing, electronics production, the photovoltaic (solar energy) sector, biotechnology research, and medical equipment fabrication. Beyond screens, Brave C&H also provides a comprehensive suite of equipment for screen preparation, including stretching and coating machines, as well as exposure and washing units. Their product range extends to essential ancillary tools such as dryers, tension meters, CCD measuring systems, thickness gauges, and magnifiers. For ongoing operational needs, the company offers a wide array of consumables, which encompasses various emulsions (high-definition, dual-cure, and photopolymer), degreasers, screen fillers, emulsion removers, and squeegees. They also supply a selection of mesh materials, specifically polyester/nylon and stainless steel. Diversifying its industrial offerings, Brave C&H features pad printing machinery, including continuous and rotary systems tailored for the closure industry, hermetic multi-color printing systems, and general rotary printing units. The company further supplies industrial filters and conveyance belts. Established in 1983, Brave C&H Supply Co.,Ltd. operates from its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
